title: After 2 weeks of late-evening coding after my day job, I finished my browser game Browser City Tycoon (inspired by OpenTTD / SimCity)
author: OpenTech-0994
selftext:
**Hey everyone!**

I work full-time in finance, but over the last two weeks, I spent my evenings vibe-coding (or vibe engineering) and building a browser game step-by-step after normal working hours. Today, I would like to present you the version  1.0 of Browser City Tycoon!

Growing up on classics like TTD and SimCity, I had a solid idea of what I wanted the gameplay, isometric view, and city economy to feel like. What caught me off guard was the backend side of things! Building it incrementally evening after evening meant picking up completely new skills on the fly, from Cloudflare hosting to Firebase backend setup for user progress saves.

It’s 100% free to play straight **from your browser:**

[https://browsercitytycoon.com/](https://browsercitytycoon.com/)

**Guest Mode:** Play immediately with progress saved in your current browser.

**Account Mode:** Cloud save your progress across devices.

I'm not sure where this project will end up going, but I hope it encourages anyone working a regular work to take on that project you’ve been dreaming about.

**The stack:**

* **Built with:** Claude (code), Suno AI (music) + Gemini (prompt adjustments)
* **Game:** vanilla JS + HTML5 Canvas in a single HTML file.
* **Backend:** Firebase (Google sign-in, cloud saves, leaderboards)
* **Hosting:** Cloudflare Workers
* **Cost:** Claude Pro + The domain, everything else on free tiers

Would love for you to give it a try and share any thoughts or feedback!
